changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: One-time conversion (issue #293): the zone-less TIMESTAMP columns the app filled in while the server ran in UTC hold UTC wall-clock time; rewrite each as the America/Los_Angeles wall-clock time of the same instant, which is what the app writes from now on. BACK UP THE DATABASE FIRST. Roll back with: liquibase rollback-count 1 (converts every value back to UTC; the repeated hour in November comes back an hour early). users.last_online (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) and the UCSB quarter calendar (already Pacific) are not touched.
